'''Enja Ode''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]], who worked as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Personality and traits==
Ode was vivacious and a skilled pilot. She did not like to risk her life on a regular basis.

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing game]] adventure ''[[At Your Service]]'', if none of the player characters have the skills to be a pilot, then Ode is hired by the [[Almas Academy]] to fly the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Seeker (YT-1300 light freighter)|''Seeker'']] for them.
